top sfyprobe_s/e1.shbench for Spectre
== analogLib/nmos.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso analogLib/nmos"
  vibox 0 -30 40 30
  vsym 76f609e6007173c0

pin D inout 40 -30
  vplabel none
  vpfig 8 8
pin G inout 0 0
  vplabel none
  vpfig 8 8
pin S inout 40 30
  vplabel none
  vpfig 8 8

param model ""
  kind string
  doc Model
param w ""
  kind string
  unit m
  doc "Gate width"
param l ""
  kind string
  unit m
  doc "Gate length"
param m ""
  kind string
  doc "Parallel copies"
param region ""
  kind choice
  choices "" off triode sat subth
  doc "Region hint"
param bn S
  kind string
  doc "Bulk net"

impl spice spice
  format spectre "{name} ({D} {G} {S}) {model}{w != \"\" ? \" w=\" + w : \"\"}{l != \"\" ? \" l=\" + l : \"\"}{m != \"\" ? \" m=\" + m : \"\"}{region != \"\" ? \" region=\" + region : \"\"}"
  format cdl "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {bn == \"D\" ? D : bn == \"G\" ? G : bn == \"S\" ? S : bn} NM{m != \"\" ? \" m=\" + m : \"\"}{l != \"\" ? \" L=\" + l : \"\"}{w != \"\" ? \" W=\" + w : \"\"}"

line 0 0 18 0
line 40 -30 40 30

stext 45 -5 R0 {model}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing lowerLeft stick IL cdsParam(1) {model}
stext 45 10 R0 l={l}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing lowerLeft stick IL cdsParam(2) l={l}
stext 45 25 R0 w={w}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing lowerLeft stick IL cdsParam(3) w={w}
stext 45 -20 R0 {name}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing7 lowerLeft stick IL cdsName() {name}
== analogLib/res.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso analogLib/res"
  vibox -20 0 20 60
  vsym a8ae32727267130d

pin PLUS inout 0 0
  vplabel none
  vpfig 8 8
pin MINUS inout 0 60
  vplabel none
  vpfig 8 8

param model ""
  kind string
  doc "Model (empty: the built-in resistor)"
param r 1k
  unit Ohm
  doc Ohms
param m ""
  kind string
  doc "Parallel copies"
param tc1 ""
  kind string
  doc "First-order tempco"
param tc2 ""
  kind string
  doc "Second-order tempco"
param isnoisy ""
  kind choice
  choices "" yes no
  doc Noisy

impl spice spice
  format spice "R{name} {PLUS} {MINUS} {r}{m != \"\" ? \" m=\" + m : \"\"}"
  format spectre "{name} ({PLUS} {MINUS}) {model != \"\" ? model : \"resistor\"} r={r}{m != \"\" ? \" m=\" + m : \"\"}{tc1 != \"\" ? \" tc1=\" + tc1 : \"\"}{tc2 != \"\" ? \" tc2=\" + tc2 : \"\"}{isnoisy != \"\" ? \" isnoisy=\" + isnoisy : \"\"}"
  format cdl "R{name} {PLUS} {MINUS} R={r} $[RP]"

rect -8 15 8 45

line 0 0 0 15
line 0 45 0 60

stext 15 25 R0 r={r}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing lowerLeft stick IL cdsParam(1) r={r}
stext 15 40 R0 tc1={tc1}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing lowerLeft stick IL cdsParam(2) tc1={tc1}
stext 15 55 R0 tc2={tc2}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing lowerLeft stick IL cdsParam(3) tc2={tc2}
stext 15 10 R0 {name}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing7 lowerLeft stick IL cdsName() {name}
== basic/cds_thru.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso basic/cds_thru"
  vibox 0 -20 120 20
  vsym 277cd0e5301be0fb

pin src inout 0 0
  vplabel none
  vpfig 8 8
pin dst inout 120 0
  vplabel none
  vpfig 8 8

param r 100m
  unit Ohm
  doc "Short resistance"

impl spice spice
  format spice "V{name} {src} {dst} 0"
  format spectre "{name} ({src} {dst}) iprobe"
  format cdl "R{name} {src} {dst} R={r} $[SH]"

line 0 0 120 0
== schemify.project
schemify 1 project

lib analogLib path analogLib
lib basic path basic
lib sfyprobe_s path sfyprobe_s
